summary: Refactored FakeAgentClient.ts into a thin facade that delegates to new cohesive fake-client capability/state modules (state, sessions, prompt-stream, projects, resources, tool-policy, extensions, fixtures), preserving the public import path/class, dev ?fake wiring, deterministic semantics, events, and fake sessions/resources/projects/git behavior. Verified with prettier, app svelte-check (0 errors/warnings), and the full app vitest suite (28 files, 165 tests passing); no commit created.
decisions: Split FakeAgentClient into a thin facade plus capability/state modules under apps/app/src/lib/agent-client/fake-client/ (state.ts, sessions.ts, prompt-stream.ts, projects.ts, resources.ts, tool-policy.ts, extensions.ts, fixtures.ts) to keep each file <=300 LOC.
Preserved the public FakeAgentClient export and class name from the original import path so consumers (apps/app/src/main.ts, lib/agent-client/index.ts) require no changes.
Kept mutable fake state per client instance rather than module-level, to preserve deterministic instance semantics the existing tests rely on.
Did not split or modify the existing FakeAgentClient.test.ts (57 LOC, well under 300) since it remained valid against the facade.
AgentStore, WebSocketAgentClient, App.svelte, and agent-server files were left untouched even though they appeared as concurrent working-tree changes.
